<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex45042024-08-2914-22-289" status="finalized">de la snga ma dgag <expan>pa'i</expan> phyir | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3892">chos rje</rs> nyid kyi <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5564">rigs pa'i gter</rs> las |
               <quote source="db:5564" n="X"><!--T329--><lg><l>la la brda dang tha snyad kyi |</l> 
               <l><expan>grags</expan> pa 2 su 'byed pa yod ||</l> 
               <l>tha snyad 'di yi skabs don min ||</l> 
               <l><expan>mtshan nyid</expan> de 'dra sngar bkag zin ||</l></lg>
               <lg><l>dngos dang zhen <expan>pa'i</expan> <choice><orig>rjod</orig><reg>brjod</reg></choice> rung gis ||</l> 
               <l>brda'i <expan>grags</expan> pa'ang 2 zhes zer || </l>
               <l>'chad na 2 su yod mod kyi</l> <l><lb n="107a4"/> 'jug pa'i tshe na rnam dbye med ||</l> 
               <l>des na bshad tshul rnam pa 2 ||</l> <l>dngos dang <expan>zhen par</expan> 'chad pa 'khrul ||</l> </lg></quote>
               zhes bkag nas 
            
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3892">rje</rs> rang gi bzhed pa ni | 
               bshad tshul 2 las 
               <quote source="db:5564" n="X"><!--T329-330--><lg><l>snga mas sgra byung <expan>grags</expan> pa la ||</l> <l><expan>rjes dpag</expan> med phyir mi <expan>khegs</expan> pa'am ||</l> <l>yang na dang la 'gal zla med ||</l> <l>des na nges phyir gnod byed yin ||</l></lg> 
               
              <lg> <l>phyi ma <expan>grags pa'i</expan> <lb n="107a5"/> <expan>rjes dpag</expan> las ||</l> <l>yul gyi dbye ba bstan pa yin ||</l> <l>de ltar shes na grags pa yi ||</l> <l>bsal pa mkhas pa'i dgongs pas 'grub ||</l> </lg></quote>
               <expan>ces gsung ngo</expan> |</seg></TEI>
